logos.title: All Generation Names and Years
logos.description: Discover all the generation names by year. From Baby Boomers to Gen Z, explore different generation names and their defining years. Understanding generation names and ages helps you identify which generation you belong to.

Greatest Generation.description: Those who lived through the Great Depression and World War II, known for their resilience, sense of duty, and sacrifice. They built the foundation of the modern world.

Silent Generation.description: Growing up in the post-war era, they witnessed the Civil Rights Movement and the Cold War. Known for hard work, traditional values, and respect for authority.

Baby Boomers.description: The post-war baby boom generation experienced economic prosperity, cultural revolution, and technological advancement. They reshaped social norms and pursued personal freedom.

Gen X.description: Coming of age during the end of the Cold War and the rise of the internet, this generation is independent and adaptable, bridging the analog and digital worlds.

Millennials.description: Growing up with the internet and globalization, Millennials value work-life balance, social justice, and technological innovation. They pioneered the digital native lifestyle.

Gen Z.description: True digital natives who grew up with smartphones and social media. This generation champions diversity, mental health awareness, and social change through technology.

Gen Alpha.description: Growing up in an AI and smart device environment, they will be the most tech-literate generation. Their education and upbringing are experiencing unprecedented digital transformation.

Gen Beta.description: The upcoming generation that will grow up in an even more intelligent and connected world. They will face global challenges like climate change and AI ubiquity while shaping the future.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions About What Generation Am I
faq.description: Common questions about generation names and how to find your generation

items.question: What generation am I if I was born in 1995?
items.answer: If you were born in 1995, you are a Millennial (also called Gen Y). Our tool analyzes all generation names and years to give you accurate results. Generation names by year help identify your exact generational cohort based on multiple authoritative sources.

items.question: What are all the generation names and years?
items.answer: All the generation names include: Silent Generation (1928-1945), Baby Boomers (1946-1964), Gen X (1965-1980), Millennials/Gen Y (1981-1996), Gen Z (1997-2012), and Gen Alpha (2013-present). These generation names and years are based on widely accepted definitions from demographic researchers.

items.question: How do I find what generation am I?
items.answer: Simply enter your birth year in our tool to find what generation am I. Our AI analyzes different generation names and compares your birth year against years and generation names from multiple sources to provide accurate generational identification.

items.question: What are the different generation names?
items.answer: Different generation names include traditional names like Baby Boomers, Gen X, Millennials, Gen Z, and newer names like Gen Alpha. Some generations also have alternative names - for example, Millennials are sometimes called Gen Y. Our database covers all generational names and their variations.

items.question: How are generation names and ages calculated?
items.answer: Generation names and ages are calculated based on birth year ranges. Each generation spans approximately 15-20 years. Our tool uses your birth year to determine which generation you belong to and calculates your current age within that generational cohort using years and names of generations data.

items.question: Why are there different generation names for the same years?
items.answer: Different sources may use slightly different generation names and year ranges. For example, some sources define Millennials as 1981-1996, while others use 1980-1995. Our tool analyzes multiple authoritative sources to show you all generation names that might apply to your birth year, helping you understand the variations in generational names.
